Remark
[converse to Toponogov comparison]

Source: petersen:page-0502 ↗ thm:pet-ch12-toponogov 1. ch12:12.8.4Show that the converse of Toponogov's theorem holds: if for some $k$ the conclusion of section 2 holds when hinges (or triangles) are compared to the same objects in $S_k^2$, then $\sec \ge k$.
